setlist_extra.title: It's All Over Now, Baby Blue

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Spoonful** (2 reviews): Garcia's guitar was partly off; he faced his amp and played little, then left before drums; Weir's delivery of Spoonful is praised, forming a serious blues pairing with Smokestack Lightning [11][17]
- **Stagger Lee** (1 review): Reviewer finds Stagger Lee unusual in a show that opens with Half Step, alongside a Big Railroad Blues [18]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): The China Cat/Rider through Samson, He's Gone, Spoonful and Good Time Blues run before drums stood out [13]
- **Never Trust a Woman** (1 review): Reviewer calls this pairing with Good Time Blues the best version they have heard [12]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): Reviewer rates the Throwing Stones into Not Fade Away pairing as exceptional, the best they've heard [12]
- **It's All Over Now, Baby Blue** (1 review): Garcia closed with a gentle encore of Baby Blue instead of a rocking finish [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **ItÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂs All Over Now**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **HeÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂs Gone**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **ItÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂs All Over Now Baby Blue**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]

## The recordings

- **gd85-11-17.sbd.barbella.12360.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 144 min; rated 3/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: Brent's vocals on the pre-drums tune carry noticeable reverb on this soundboard [17]
- **gd1985-11-17.148830.fob.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 21 songs; 145 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: This audience recording conveys Phil's power better than any other the reviewer knows, notably at the start of Samson [18]
- **gd1985-11-17.178711.nak700.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 147 min [3]
- **gd1985-11-17.172966.nak700.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 149 min [5]
- **gd85-11-17.schoeps.barbella.12361.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 146 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [10]. Said about its sound: Reviewer advises setting EQ carefully and playing it loud to appreciate this Schoeps recording [15]

## Around the show

- Brent stayed on stage for one more tune before drums after Garcia left [11]
- Reviewer's first Dead show, attended while intoxicated; they knew almost none of the songs beforehand [13]
- Garcia left the stage during Brent's pre-drums song, which reviewer sees as giving Brent room to shine [17]
- Reviewer felt this show did not top the previous night's, though the first set rocked throughout [11]
- Reviewer ranks the opening set, from Half Step through Looks Like Rain, among the best first sets heard [14]
- Reviewer considers this a neglected show and possibly the best listening experience of 1985 [15]
- Reviewer says a Brent tune between early second set and drums was common in 1985, and the band seemed disjointed [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd85-11-17.sbd.barbella.12360.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Cassette > DAT > CD uploaded by Steve Barbella [1]
- **gd1985-11-17.148830.fob.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Neumann KM84i mics > Sony D5M [2]. Also: A 15-second patch in Drums comes from an audience source shared by Jon Bernstein; the Wheel space is kept [2]
- **gd1985-11-17.178711.nak700.bradt.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bill Bradt; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bill Bradt's Master Audience Cassettes: Nakamichi 700 mics > NX40 dbx > Sony D5M (Maxell MX-90) [3]. Also: The Neumann KM84i source supplies a 9-second patch in Drums and a 25-second patch in Space [3]
- **gd1985-11-17.172966.nak700.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Bob Menke's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-D5M [5]. Also: Two sets of Nakamichi 700 masters were combined to make the recording complete [5]
- **gd85-11-17.schoeps.barbella.12361.sbeok.shnf**: source: Schoeps MK41Âs > PCM > DAT > CDR uploaded by Steve Barbella [10]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1985-11-17 Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1985-11-17-backstage-pass/) [21]
